title.narrative: Green Transformation in Public Buildings Program

description.narrative: The proposed Green Transformation in Public Buildings (GIPUB) Program uses a results-based lending (RBL) modality and will support the government's broader program in energy efficiency improvement of public buildings in the Kyrgyz Republic. The RBL program will focus on public buildings outside of Bishkek as the fiscal capacity in those areas is relatively weak and the conditions of public buildings are more dilapidated. Renovating public buildings outside of Bishkek will generate a higher energy efficiency potential and climate mitigation impact while benefiting the needy and vulnerable public building users, such as kids, pupils, students, and patients.
